tagline.en_US: Smokeping keeps track of your network latency. For a full example of what this application is capable of visit UCDavis.

description.en_US: Smokeping is a network monitoring tool designed to track and record network latency. It actively probes configured network targets to measure round-trip times and packet loss, generating visual graphs to illustrate connection quality over time. It helps administrators identify performance degradation, intermittent outages, and overall network health.
